Well, 12 good men and women. I just beat an "Impregnable" mission on Xcom 2 Long War.

Playing on Commander I am about 20 missions in. Using Long War 2 mod, Spectre class, Rogue class and Infantry class. Also the Shen and Aliens DLC.

I know the classes are semi-redundant due to the modified classes in the LW2 pack but I like the variation. They share a lot of the same skills but have some unique niches to fill.

If you're not familiar with "Long War" it is free DLC of the highest quality. You fight many more fights, and must send squads off at the same time to take different objectives. It has a squad management system and new types of missions.

I'm playing "Commander" and at 20 missions in I have only lost one unit to capture. He was stunned by the new Advent Sentry Drones and didn't make the EVAC. [You can't carry a stunned unit]

I've got one squad for wetwork - a Rogue who carries the Bolter and spots targets for a Sharpshooter. I will sneak to the evac point and put the Sharpshooter on high ground then spot the target with my rogue. I've successfully completed 3 or 4 missions with them only.

One mechanic you have is the length of time it takes to infiltrate a squad into a location. If you have good intel and you learn of an opportunity early, you can sneak a squad in without the enemy knowing and no reinforcements will be sent in. The LW2 mod does a much better job of making it seem like the planet has been conquered, you can't go head to head against the aliens because they bring overwhelming force to bear except in rare opportunities.

So aside from the Wetworks duo I have another squad that is 3 ranger/shinobi types who are good at extracting VIP's. They can sneak to the VIP location and provide cover for a quick evac. This team hasn't been quite as successful as the wetwork squad but they have done a few jailbreak missions.

With LW2 there is no way to do every mission. The way the LW2 mod works is the enemy initiatives are happening in the background at all times and you just need good intel and proximity to the site to get a squad in without bringing in reinforcements. You can tell how well infiltrated you are before you pop the cork with indicators like "light", "very light", "medium" or "impregnable".

"very light" is manageable with my 2-man spectre squads but not easy to take on in the open. Infiltrating a bigger squad takes more time, as well.

So after a few hard-fought victories, I decided to try my hand at "Impregnable". I saw an opportunity for a "supply raid" mission with 0 time left on the timer [meaning full enemy response] and sent in the last 12 units I had.

The irregular squad I sent in was comprised of the "Devils" who were already irregulars. A Gunner leading a group of low-level squaddies, an assault, a specialist/healer, a grenadier, some rookies... I added in a few scouts [spectres, rangers, rogues] that I had in auxiliary [they join up with other squads to provide scouting on hot-drop missions] and we had our fight.

Apparently "Impregnable" on Commander difficulty at this point in the campaign is 36 enemies.

We went in concealed, I pulled back and found a corner of the map with no patrols and some high ground/cover. We triggered our first sortie to take out an entire squad of 9 in two turns with no casualties, and without triggering the next pod. From then it was hours and hours of slugging it out. One unit hit bad enough to need stabilization [which my newbie specialist was only just able to provide]. I would draw each new pod back into ambush and made heavy use of "slash" and some of the new shinobi/ranger abilities to weed out anyone who got too close.

LW2 is tough as heck but also incredibly fun and more diverse than vanilla. Highly recommend.
